applies_to.notes: First-party M003 named register(on) declaration plus real, disposable Mac CLI 2.1.296 strict validation and offline .test.ts factory-export negative control; no later-version or host production guarantee.

evidence.notes: M003 #files gives the approved named `export function register(on)` loader shape. A separate disposable Mac CLI2.1.296 strict validation of a synthetic `export const register = createRegister()` (where createRegister returns a real function) exits 1, says register exported as something other than a function, and CLI native .test.ts exits1 with Hook module load failure. This claim is narrower than claiming all const exports invalid in all versions.

statement: 在 Claude Code CLI 2.1.296 的 Mods hooks 文件中，使用命名函数声明 `export function register(on)`；不要把工厂返回值形式 `export const register = createRegister()` 当作等价的注册入口，即使 `createRegister()` 在 JavaScript 中确实返回函数。针对一个隔离、可重复的 Mod，原生 `claude plugin validate --strict .` 对该工厂式导出退出码为 1（静态发现提示 register 导出不是函数声明），`claude plugin test .` 因 hooks 模块无法加载也失败。用真实目标 CLI 检查完整的插件入口；这不是后续 CLI 版本、其他宿主或模型生成代码的普遍保证。
subject: mods.types.factory-assigned-register-export-rejected
